comment: Shared by tests/solid-bubble.test.ts (solidFill in src/app/bot-tint.ts) and the iOS SolidBubble.fill test. Each case is an assistant color and the fill a person's solid bubble takes from it, as uppercase #RRGGBB, or null when the color is not a hex value. White text keeps at least 4.5:1 on every fill. The closest any channel comes to a rounding tie is 0.012 of a byte (#FF6700's red), far above the last-digit differences between JavaScript's and Swift's math.

cases.name: avatar palette brown, whose capped lightness needs no chroma cut
avatar palette charcoal, already dark, keeps its color
an already dark color keeps its color
pure blue sits under the cap and keeps its color
white darkens to the cap's gray
the app's green, which a group chat's solid bubble takes, keeps its color
a value that is not a hex color has no fill
